Name: Nadab, Son of Shammai
Summary: Son of Shammai and father of Seled and Appaim.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:28: Son of Shammai and father of Seled and Appaim.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Nadab stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
